title: Invoices, PDF templates, email and spreadsheet exports
summary: Typed invoice, estimate, receipt, packing-slip and report models drive editable pdfme templates and dynamic PDFs; invoice email/XLSX/CSV and bounded Gotenberg/Typst adapters provide complementary output profiles.

profiles: Node 24.19.0 + React/ReactDOM 19.3.0; TypeScript build and ten tests including real pdfme PDFs for five document types, a 90-row multi-page report with a supplied font map, React Email, ExcelJS reload and PapaParse round trips.
Node 24.19.0; mocked Gotenberg HTTP boundary and controlled executable Typst argument/JSON/cleanup fixtures; neither external converter was run.
notes: Browser PDF designer interactions, a live Gotenberg service and a real Typst compiler were not exercised.
The invoice uses integer minor units; tax rules, fonts/assets, legal invoice requirements, visual output and email-client acceptance remain application-specific.
React 18 fits peer ranges but was not executed; server conversion and spreadsheet modules must remain outside browser bundles.
